instruction: Please help me set up VS Code to use spaces instead of tabs when I press the Tab key, as my team's coding standard requires space-based indentation.

metadata.explanation: Task requires the agent to modify VS Code settings.json to enable space insertion instead of tabs. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings function to verify insertSpaces is set to true.
metadata.verification: The check_json_settings function verifies that settings.json contains 'editor.insertSpaces': true. No new functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking that VS Code uses spaces instead of tabs
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly retrieves the VS Code settings.json file from the correct path: /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric (check_json_settings) correctly compares the expected setting 'editor.insertSpaces': true against the actual settings file
Expected value is semantically correct: 'editor.insertSpaces': true is the standard VS Code setting for making Tab key insert spaces
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (spaces instead of tabs) and evaluator checks exactly that setting
State accessibility: settings.json is persistently saved by VS Code, no special postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: file retrieval -> JSON parsing -> key-value comparison works correctly at runtime
